title: StatusIndicator
description: A small badge that shows the status of an item or the presence of a user.

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.description: Four semantic statuses, each with its own color and icon.

presence.title: Presence
presence.description: Use type to show user presence: online, away, busy or offline.

custom-color.title: Custom color
custom-color.description: Set type="custom" and pass any CSS color.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Clicking an indicator plays a short feedback animation; disabled turns it off.

StatusIndicatorProps.status: Status, which sets the color and icon
StatusIndicatorProps.type: Presence type; overrides the status color. Use "custom" together with color
StatusIndicatorProps.showLabel: Shows a text label next to the indicator (presence types only)
StatusIndicatorProps.color: Custom background color, applied when type is "custom"
